hidden_dual_route_1.name: {name}
hidden_dual_route_1.text: *As I finish cleaning up after the event, I put the literature club critique copy and first-aid card in my bag. I don't yet know what these memories will mean years from now.*

hidden_dual_route_choice.name: {name}
hidden_dual_route_choice.text: *I take out one of the two records first. None of these relationships need to be decided today.*
choices: Open the literature club critique copy

hidden_perfect_homeroom_1.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_1.text: *On graduation day, my homeroom teacher hands me a copy of my recommendation and my reading record. A teacherly farewell, right to the end.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_1b.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_1b.text: *At the door of the empty classroom, she sorts the literature club critique copies. Each manuscript is marked only with a student number.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_2.text: Congratulations on graduating. Your recommendation and reading record are in the envelope. Check at home that nothing is missing.

hidden_perfect_homeroom_2c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_2c.text: The critique helped me finish it. I sent it to a publisher too. Whatever happens is mine to handle. You take care of yourself.

hidden_perfect_homeroom_3.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_3.text: *After the classroom door closed that day, we had no private contact. Four years later, {name} had graduated from college and was living alone near their first job.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_3b.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_3b.text: *At a bookstore café on my way home from work, I spot a familiar name on a poster for a new-book talk. When I look up, she sees me too.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_3c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_3c.text: ...What a coincidence. *She sets down the event materials.* If you have time, would you like to sit?

hidden_perfect_homeroom_3e.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_3e.text: I'm still teaching at the same school. And I published a book. — What kind of work are you doing these days?

hidden_perfect_homeroom_3f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_3f.text: Would you like to meet here again? There's a lot we didn't get to talk about today.

hidden_perfect_homeroom_3g.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_3g.text: *We save our names and numbers in each other's phones—information that was never part of the old school contact list.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_4b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_4b.text: *At our second meeting, she takes a copy of her book from the shelf.* This time it's the published edition. Will you read it and tell me what you think?

hidden_perfect_homeroom_4c.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_4c.text: *I return to the home I live in alone and read the book until dawn—this time, at a reader's pace.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_4d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_4d.text: *At our next meeting in the café, she stirs her coffee once and lets go of the spoon.* ...What did you think?

hidden_perfect_homeroom_4e.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_4e.text: *{name} chooses the third meeting. After work, they wait on a café terrace overlooking the cherry blossoms, straightening the bouquet's wrapping once more.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_4f.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_4f.text: *I hand her the bouquet.* It's to celebrate the book—and to say that I want to see you again.

hidden_perfect_homeroom_4g.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_perfect_homeroom_4g.text: *Holding the bouquet, she looks at {name}.* May I take it to mean the same thing?

hidden_perfect_homeroom_5.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_5.text: *We leave the café and walk at the same pace. The bouquet wrapping rustles softly in the evening breeze.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep1.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep1.text: *We spend longer talking about the past four years than about school.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep2.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep2.text: *We take turns choosing our next plans: Thursdays are hers, Saturdays are {name}'s.*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep3.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep3.text: *Her second book is published. Instead of a specific name, the dedication reads, 'To the readers who stayed to the end and answered in their own words.'*

hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep4.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_homeroom_ep4.text: *We ask about each other's work and choose another weekend. Our old roles are neither a secret to erase nor a joke to revisit; we leave them where they belong, in a time that has already ended.*

hidden_true_homeroom_1.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_1.text: *Four years after graduation. The two have had no private contact in all that time. After leaving school, graduating from college, and learning to support themself, {name} spots a book-talk poster bearing a familiar name at an independent bookstore on the way home from work.*

hidden_true_homeroom_2.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_2.text: *After the event, the signing table finally clears. The author, dressed in a beige cardigan, looks up from arranging her books.*

hidden_true_homeroom_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_2_b.text: *A company ID hangs from {name}'s neck. In her hands is a book printed with her own name instead of an attendance register.*

hidden_true_homeroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_3.text: It's been a long time. What should I call you now?

hidden_true_homeroom_3_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_3_b.text: Call me by my name. I'm not a student anymore.

hidden_true_homeroom_3_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_3_c.text: Let's take that slowly. You came as a reader today, right?

hidden_true_homeroom_4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_4.text: *She glances at my ID and smiles.* You've really built a life of your own.

hidden_true_homeroom_4_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_4_b.text: *Before school comes up, we talk about our jobs and the books we've been reading lately.*

hidden_true_homeroom_4_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_4_c.text: *She takes a book from the display. It has the same title as the manuscript once kept in her desk.*

hidden_true_homeroom_4_d.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_4_d.text: I finished it in the end. I spent a long time with the critique the literature club gave me back then.

hidden_true_homeroom_4_e.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_4_e.text: Do you remember the marks I left?

hidden_true_homeroom_4_f.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_4_f.text: We agreed I wouldn't try to identify anyone's comments. I do remember that someone left an unusual number of questions on the final page.

hidden_true_homeroom_4_g.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_4_g.text: *She squares the corner of the book once. She doesn't fold the cup sleeve the way she used to.*

hidden_true_homeroom_4_h.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_4_h.text: The event's over—do you have time? I'd like to get coffee. If that would make you uncomfortable, we can just say goodbye here.

hidden_true_homeroom_5.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_5.text: I'd like to get to know who you are now, not the student you used to be.

hidden_true_homeroom_5_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_5_b.text: *She waits for {name}'s answer instead of walking toward the register.*

hidden_true_homeroom_5_c.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_5_c.text: I'd like to get to know who you are now too. We can take our time deciding what to call each other.

hidden_true_homeroom_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_6.text: Good. Then coffee first. We can talk about the rest over a cup.

hidden_true_homeroom_6_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_6_b.text: *On the walk to the café, we ask about each other's commutes and current work.*

hidden_true_homeroom_7.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_7.text: I'd like that. And I'd like to make another plan too.

hidden_true_homeroom_7_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_7_b.text: *Smiling, she takes out her phone and shows her contact screen first, then waits.*

hidden_true_homeroom_7_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_7_c.text: Starting today, let's not force ourselves to erase the old title. But let's learn each other's names again first.

hidden_true_homeroom_7_d.name: {name}
hidden_true_homeroom_7_d.text: *I say her name once. She slowly says {name}'s in return.*

hidden_true_homeroom_8.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_true_homeroom_8.text: *Across the cake plate, {name} holds out a hand. After a moment, she gently takes it and hides her smile behind her other hand.* Would you like to meet again next week?

hidden_good_homeroom_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_good_homeroom_1.text: *After the graduation ceremony, she calls {name} over while sorting copies of recommendation letters and the literature club's critique packet in the empty classroom.* These are your records. Check that nothing's missing.

hidden_good_homeroom_2.name: {name}
hidden_good_homeroom_2.text: *I take the envelope, and we walk out into the hall together. The last students head down the stairs while my homeroom teacher gathers the remaining manuscripts and papers in her arms.*

hidden_good_homeroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_good_homeroom_3.text: Keep writing. I'll finish my manuscript. Let's each focus on our own work first.

hidden_good_homeroom_4.name: {name}
hidden_good_homeroom_4.text: *After saying goodbye, {name} walks to the end of the hall and looks back. The homeroom teacher stands by the window, seeing the graduates off. They give her a small bow, then leave the school.*

hidden_perfect_nurse_1.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_1.text: *Five years after graduation. I've worked away from home and lived alone for two years. At a local weekend health event, I spot a familiar name on the first-aid instructor's badge: Lee Juwon.*

hidden_perfect_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_perfect_nurse_2.text: *After the event, she removes the badge from her coat.* ...{name}? I never expected to see you here.

hidden_perfect_nurse_3.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_3.text: *We sit across from each other at a café opposite the venue. The practice bandages remain packed in their box.*

hidden_perfect_nurse_3b.name: School Nurse
hidden_perfect_nurse_3b.text: I used to be responsible for your counseling. Are you sure you're comfortable sitting down with me like this now?

hidden_perfect_nurse_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_perfect_nurse_4.text: If you're uncomfortable, we can stop at hello. I was only curious how you've been.

hidden_perfect_nurse_4b.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_4b.text: I'm comfortable. And today, I'd rather hear about you than about school.

hidden_perfect_nurse_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_perfect_nurse_5.text: Then shall we make our next meeting neither treatment nor counseling?

hidden_perfect_nurse_5b.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_5b.text: *We compare calendars until we find a Saturday when we're both free.*

hidden_perfect_nurse_ep1.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_ep1.text: *Several months later. After spending a number of weekends together, they wake up together for the first time. Juwon finds {name}'s hand beneath the covers and clasps it. {name} holds on.*

hidden_perfect_nurse_ep2.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_ep2.text: *After that morning, heading to Juwon's place on weekends began to feel natural. As the time they spent together slowly grew, Juwon transferred to the education team at a university hospital. Patients and newly hired nurses alike now called her by the same title—Instructor Lee Juwon.*

hidden_perfect_nurse_ep3.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_ep3.text: *The rosemary plant sits on the windowsill of the home we chose together. We take turns watering it.*

hidden_perfect_nurse_ep4.name: {name}
hidden_perfect_nurse_ep4.text: *One line remains on the final page of the pale green notebook: 'It took a long time, but now I'll begin again by my own choice.'*

hidden_true_nurse_1.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_1.text: *Four years after graduation. One spring evening, a year after moving out on my own, I hear a familiar voice at a local health campaign booth on my way home from work.*

hidden_true_nurse_2.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_2.text: *After the event, we sit across from each other again at a nearby café. The bandages and leaflets from the booth are packed away in her bag.*

hidden_true_nurse_2_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_2_b.text: *Two different company IDs rest on the table. We both look like adults who have made it through another day on our own.*

hidden_true_nurse_2_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_2_c.text: It's been a long time. Have you been well?

hidden_true_nurse_2_d.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_2_d.text: Yes. I have a job now too, and I live on my own.

hidden_true_nurse_3.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_3.text: Even what we call each other is complicated. Would it feel strange if you still called me 'teacher'?

hidden_true_nurse_3_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_3_b.text: We can change that slowly. There's no rush.

hidden_true_nurse_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_4.text: I remember you walking in dizzy on your first day after transferring.

hidden_true_nurse_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_5.text: Back then, we were teacher and student, so that was where it ended.

hidden_true_nurse_5_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_5_b.text: *Juwon lets go of her coffee cup and waits for {name}'s answer.*

hidden_true_nurse_5_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_5_c.text: Now we've met again by chance.

hidden_true_nurse_5_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_5_d.text: So I'll ask: would you like to meet again?

hidden_true_nurse_5_f.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_5_f.text: *She gives a dry laugh.* Right. A bandage should take under three minutes.

hidden_true_nurse_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_6.text: If this makes you uncomfortable, we can end it here. If not, I'd like to see you again next week.

hidden_true_nurse_7.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_7.text: *We leave the café and walk side by side to the subway station. Neither of us changes direction to follow the other.*

hidden_true_nurse_7_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_7_b.text: You can answer about next week after you get home.

hidden_true_nurse_7_c.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_7_c.text: It isn't a no. I'd like to see you again too.

hidden_true_nurse_7_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_7_d.text: *She takes out her phone and opens her calendar.* Then next weekend. We'll find a day that works for both of us.

hidden_true_nurse_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_8.text: Next time, let's skip the health event and just meet.

hidden_true_nurse_8_b.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_8_b.text: *For three months, we meet at a different café every weekend. That day, Juwon invites me to her home for the first time.*

hidden_true_nurse_8_c.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_8_c.text: *We choose a movie and sit side by side on the sofa. It is dark outside, and the two cups of coffee on the table slowly go cold.*

hidden_true_nurse_8_d.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_8_d.text: *We don't spend long talking about school. There is more to say about work now and next weekend.*

hidden_true_nurse_8_e.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_8_e.text: Back then, I did think about leaving the school.

hidden_true_nurse_8_f.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_8_f.text: But staying was your choice, wasn't it?

hidden_true_nurse_8_g.name: School Nurse
hidden_true_nurse_8_g.text: Right. I chose it—not because anyone held me there. Coming here today was my choice too.

hidden_true_nurse_8_h.name: {name}
hidden_true_nurse_8_h.text: Then I'll come by next week, too. That's my choice. *Before the movie ends, Juwon falls asleep against {name}'s shoulder.*

hidden_good_nurse_1.name: School Nurse
hidden_good_nurse_1.text: *After the graduation ceremony, the nurse's office door opens one last time. Juwon is drinking coffee by the window. When she sees {name}, she sets down her cup.* What brings you here? You shouldn't have anything wrong with you today.

hidden_good_nurse_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_good_nurse_2.text: If you came to say goodbye before you leave, sit down. As of today, your treatment here is over.

hidden_good_nurse_2_c.name: School Nurse
hidden_good_nurse_2_c.text: *After a moment's thought, she nods.* Okay. If you get hurt, don't tough it out—go to a hospital first. I won't be able to check on you anymore.

hidden_good_nurse_2_d.name: School Nurse
hidden_good_nurse_2_d.text: *She takes the pale green notebook from her desk drawer and opens it to the last page.*

hidden_good_nurse_3.name: {name}
hidden_good_nurse_3.text: *Juwon writes the date and 'Graduated, no issues' before closing the notebook. This time, she gives me neither a bandage nor her contact information.*

hidden_good_nurse_3_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_good_nurse_3_b.text: Take care. Next time we run into each other, say hello as a graduate, not a patient.

hidden_good_nurse_4.name: {name}
hidden_good_nurse_4.text: *Before leaving the nurse's office, I look back. Juwon sits by the window with her coffee cup in hand. We exchange a small bow.*

perfect_seo_1.name: {name}
perfect_seo_1.text: *On the rooftop, several planters sit beneath the railing. Damp patches remain on the soil.*

perfect_seo_1_b.name: Seoyeon
perfect_seo_1_b.text: *Seoyeon sets down the watering can. Droplets cling to the handle.*

perfect_seo_2.name: {name}
perfect_seo_2.text: *There are smudges beneath her eyes. Seoyeon folds a handkerchief and puts it in her pocket.*

perfect_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
perfect_seo_3.text: I'll only tidy up this much today.

perfect_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
perfect_seo_4.text: We'll look at the rest tomorrow.

perfect_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
perfect_seo_5.text: *Seoyeon walks toward the stairs first, then stops at the door.*

perfect_epilogue_1_seo.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_1_seo.text: *Even after graduation, the rooftop door was open from time to time.*

perfect_epilogue_2_seo.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_2_seo.text: *On the day of my university entrance ceremony, Seoyeon sends a photo of two new plants and one empty space.*

bitter_seo_1.name: {name}
bitter_seo_1.text: *About a month later, she sends a short message asking to meet at the café in front of school.*

bitter_seo_2_b.name: {name}
bitter_seo_2_b.text: *Seoyeon squares the edge of her coaster. Her coffee is still more than half full.*

bitter_seo_3.name: {name}
bitter_seo_3.text: *I leave the café. It's raining. We have one umbrella, but our bus stops are in opposite directions.*

true_seo_1.name: {name}
true_seo_1.text: *Seoyeon's room. Three plants and a file binder sit on her desk. A family photo leans beside the bookshelf.*

true_seo_2.name: {name}
true_seo_2.text: *A folded piece of paper is tucked beneath one of the plant saucers.*

true_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
true_seo_3.text: Sit down. The chair's over there.

true_seo_4.name: {name}
true_seo_4.text: *The chair scrapes softly as I pull it over.*

true_seo_5.name: Seoyeon
true_seo_5.text: Long conversations at home wear me out.

true_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
true_seo_6.text: *Seoyeon pulls the paper from beneath the plant saucer.*

true_seo_6b.name: Seoyeon
true_seo_6b.text: So I wrote it down. I didn't want to forget.

true_seo_7_b.name: Seoyeon
true_seo_7_b.text: *The paper goes back beneath the saucer.*

true_seo_7b.name: {name}
true_seo_7b.text: *Seoyeon places two cups on the desk.*

true_epilogue_1_seo.name: {name}
true_epilogue_1_seo.text: *Five days. That's how long it took to memorize where everything sat on Seoyeon's desk.*

perfect_yuna_1.name: {name}
perfect_yuna_1.text: *The library annex, the secret attic. Yuna hands over a short story.*

perfect_yuna_2.name: {name}
perfect_yuna_2.text: *The title is the main character's name.*

perfect_yuna_3.name: Yuna
perfect_yuna_3.text: ...Tell me what you think after you finish it. That's my answer.

perfect_yuna_4.name: {name}
perfect_yuna_4.text: *The ink is slightly smudged beneath the story's final sentence.*

perfect_yuna_5.name: Yuna
perfect_yuna_5.text: *She stands and hugs me without a word. Light through the cracked window stretches across the floor. The hand at my back comes to rest one beat late.*

perfect_epilogue_1_yuna.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_1_yuna.text: *I sit in the same place every day. Yuna no longer lingers on the same page for too long.*

perfect_epilogue_2_yuna.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_2_yuna.text: *Yuna's first novel is published. The dedication contains one line: 'To the person who listened to the third track with me.'*

perfect_epilogue_3_yuna.name: Yuna
perfect_epilogue_3_yuna.text: *She still doesn't say much. The notes she sends {name} have grown a little longer.*

bitter_yuna_1.name: {name}
bitter_yuna_1.text: *I confessed. Yuna nodded, but her fingers continued to rub the end of the bookmark. About a month later, a note was placed in my locker. ‘Let’s talk.’*

bitter_yuna_2_library.name: Yuna
bitter_yuna_2_library.text: ...Sometimes I think of you. When I catch the scent of old books. I should've said more back then.

bitter_yuna_2_book.name: Yuna
bitter_yuna_2_book.text: ...Sometimes I think of you. When I pass a bookstore. I should've said more back then.

bitter_yuna_3.name: {name}
bitter_yuna_3.text: *I leave through the school gate. It's raining. In the mailbox, Yuna's last note is stuck. It's short. The bottom of the paper is smeared by rain.*

true_yuna_1.name: {name}
true_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. Deeper than the secret reading spot — an attic. A space I didn’t even know existed.*

true_yuna_2.name: Yuna
true_yuna_2.text: I was the only one who knew about this place.

true_yuna_2_b.name: Yuna
true_yuna_2_b.text: *She climbs the small attic ladder. There's a hatch leading up. — When it opens, a breeze rushes in.*

true_yuna_2_c.name: {name}
true_yuna_2_c.text: *Above the attic was the library annex rooftop. A secret passage no one else knows about.*

true_yuna_2_d.name: Yuna
true_yuna_2_d.text: *She leans against the railing. The sun is setting beyond the mountains.*

true_yuna_3.name: Yuna
true_yuna_3.text: *On the low roof above the hatch, the wind lifts the corner of her notebook.*

true_yuna_4.name: Yuna
true_yuna_4.text: *She opens the playlist on her phone. A small star marks the third track.*

true_yuna_5.name: {name}
true_yuna_5.text: That third track from back then?

true_yuna_5_b.name: Yuna
true_yuna_5_b.text: *Yuna pauses for a moment. The hand holding the book spine loosens.*

true_yuna_6b.name: Yuna
true_yuna_6b.text: Today, listen to it here with me.

true_yuna_7.name: {name}
true_yuna_7.text: *The playlist has been copied into her notebook. Beside the third title is the same pale violet dot as on her first note. Yuna presses Play.*

true_yuna_bridge.name: {name}
true_yuna_bridge.text: *By the time the last song ends, a crescent moon has risen. Yuna asks, "Mind if I lean back against you?" When {name} nods, they sit back-to-back and play the next song.*

true_epilogue_1_yuna.name: {name}
true_epilogue_1_yuna.text: *Five days. That's how long it took to hear Yuna's voice beyond the notes.*

perfect_dain_1.name: {name}
perfect_dain_1.text: *In the gym, the balls are in the rack. A knee brace and rehabilitation schedule lie on the bench.*

perfect_dain_2.name: Dain
perfect_dain_2.text: I'm starting proper rehabilitation next week.

perfect_dain_2b.name: Dain
perfect_dain_2b.text: *After showing me the confirmed appointment, she sets her phone beside the knee brace.*

perfect_dain_3.name: Dain
perfect_dain_3.text: I still don't know about going pro. But I'm going to look for ways to stay involved off the court.

perfect_dain_3b.name: Dain
perfect_dain_3b.text: *She pauses a broadcast clip and points to the commentator's name beneath the video.*

perfect_dain_4.name: {name}
perfect_dain_4.text: Player or not, you're at your best when you talk about volleyball. I'll watch your first broadcast.

perfect_dain_5.name: Dain
perfect_dain_5.text: Can I hug you for a moment? *When {name} holds out their arms, Dain balances on her left foot and puts an arm around their shoulders. {name} supports her weight so none of it falls on her right knee.*

perfect_epilogue_1_dain.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_1_dain.text: *When Dain says, "You can put me down now," {name} lowers her slowly, making sure her left foot touches down first.*

perfect_epilogue_1b_dain.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_1b_dain.text: *Before her weight shifts onto her right knee, she steadies herself with a hand on {name}'s shoulder.*

perfect_epilogue_1c_dain.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_1c_dain.text: *On rehabilitation days, Dain sets the pace first. {name} walks to match her stride.*

perfect_epilogue_2_dain.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_2_dain.text: *Dain majors in sports media and joins the campus broadcast crew. The night before her first broadcast, she rewrites the script three times.*

perfect_epilogue_3_dain.name: {name}
perfect_epilogue_3_dain.text: *On painful days, we review rehabilitation notes and game footage instead of training. Now Dain is the first to say when she needs rest.*

bitter_dain_1.name: {name}
bitter_dain_1.text: *I confessed. About a month later, a text arrives asking me to wait outside the gym.*

bitter_dain_2.name: Dain
bitter_dain_2.text: It was fun! ...But I think it was only fun. That's what feels a little off.

bitter_dain_3.name: {name}
bitter_dain_3.text: *I leave the gym. Rain is falling. From behind the closed door, a ball bounces once.*

bitter_dain_3_b.name: {name}
bitter_dain_3_b.text: *I walk out through the school gate. It's raining. — No umbrella. Wet cherry petals cling to the ground at my feet.*

bitter_epilogue_1.name: {name}
bitter_epilogue_1.text: *After graduation, we speak less and less. Once a month becomes once every two months. One day, I leave only 'What should I say?' in the message box, then turn off the screen.*

bitter_epilogue_2.name: {name}
bitter_epilogue_2.text: *A record of five days remains. In the last photo, there's a gap between us wide enough for someone to walk through.*

true_dain_1.name: {name}
true_dain_1.text: *After the event, we sit side by side against the gym wall. Dain's phone is open to a hospital booking screen.*

true_dain_3.name: Dain
true_dain_3.text: I told Coach and my parents too. They really let me have it... but I felt better once I'd said it.

true_dain_4.name: {name}
true_dain_4.text: *Beneath the appointment screen, an application for the sports broadcasting club is open too.*

true_dain_6.name: Dain
true_dain_6.text: I don't know. I'll try both and choose whichever one I enjoy more.

true_dain_7.name: {name}
true_dain_7.text: Then I'll watch your first broadcast.

true_dain_8.name: Dain
true_dain_8.text: No take-backs. Even if it's boring, you have to watch to the end.

true_dain_8b.name: Dain
true_dain_8b.text: *Still cradling the volleyball, she holds out her pinky.*

true_dain_bridge.name: {name}
true_dain_bridge.text: *After sealing the promise, Dain asks, "Can I lean on you for a minute?" When {name} nods, Dain hugs the ball, leans against their shoulder, and closes her eyes. The hospital appointment confirmation remains on the phone screen.*

true_epilogue_1_dain.name: {name}
true_epilogue_1_dain.text: *That day, for the first time, Dain gives me the date of her next appointment instead of saying, 'I'm fine.'*

true_epilogue_2.name: {name}
true_epilogue_2.text: *The uniform was stiff, the cherry blossoms made me sneeze, and I had no idea what to do in front of the school gate.*

true_epilogue_3.name: {name}
true_epilogue_3.text: *But looking back, the beginning came quickly. It only took five days to admit it.*

true_epilogue_4_seo.name: {name}
true_epilogue_4_seo.text: *Her mother's calls are still short, and the note by the mirror remains. Sometimes Seoyeon speaks without a note now.*

true_epilogue_4_yuna.name: {name}
true_epilogue_4_yuna.text: *Her senior's contact is still gone. The library corner seat is still empty. But Yuna now uses her voice before notes.*

true_epilogue_4_dain.name: {name}
true_epilogue_4_dain.text: *Dain's morning alarm announces rehabilitation stretches instead of telling her to smile. Sometimes she sends a practice broadcast, and {name} watches to the end before replying with feedback.*

day5_ending_alone.name: {name}
day5_ending_alone.text: *I walk out the school gate. My phone buzzes. — Nobody. Low battery warning.*

alone_1.name: {name}
alone_1.text: *I gather the notes and photos from the past five days into one folder. I don't delete anything from anyone.*

alone_2.name: {name}
alone_2.text: *The room is quiet. On my phone screen, three chats are pinned at the top. None have new messages.*

alone_2_b.name: {name}
alone_2_b.text: *Leaving the reply box empty, I set my phone down.*

alone_4.name: {name}
alone_4.text: *I plug the phone in and set my morning alarm. Once the screen goes dark, only the ticking second hand remains in the room.*

day5_ending_confess_fail.name: {name}
day5_ending_confess_fail.text: *I make it all the way to the park and finally say it. While I wait for an answer, I can only stare at my shoes.*

confess_fail_cg_seo.name: Seoyeon
confess_fail_cg_seo.text: *After listening for a long time, she shakes her head.* I'm sorry. Not now.

confess_fail_cg_yuna.name: Yuna
confess_fail_cg_yuna.text: *We walk side by side as far as the park exit, but our hands never touch. Yuna keeps her eyes ahead as she speaks.* ...I'm sorry. I can't return your feelings.

confess_fail_cg_dain.name: Dain
confess_fail_cg_dain.text: *She wipes at the corner of her eye and tries to smile, but her voice is clear.* Sorry. I want us to stay friends.

confess_fail_1.name: {name}
confess_fail_1.text: *A few days later, at the school gate in the rain. From beneath my umbrella, I watch her walk away, but I neither call her name nor follow.*

confess_fail_2.name: {name}
confess_fail_2.text: *Still standing there, I open the chat. After typing and deleting over and over, I leave only one sentence.*

confess_fail_3.name: {name}
confess_fail_3.text: *I send, 'I understand. Thank you for answering,' then set my phone down.*

confess_fail_4.name: {name}
confess_fail_4.text: *A read receipt appears. No reply follows. I don't send anything else.*

day5_ending_good.name: {name}
day5_ending_good.text: *Not much changes after the confession. I simply have one more plan on my calendar.*

good_1.name: {name}
good_1.text: *For several days, our conversations keep faltering. Even so, we don't stop talking.*

good_1b.name: {name}
good_1b.text: *The two of us leave by the same road.*

good_1c.name: {name}
good_1c.text: *A cherry blossom petal sticks to the front of my shoe, then falls off on the next step.*

good_1_seo_b.name: Seoyeon
good_1_seo_b.text: *Seoyeon removes a petal caught on the cuff of {name}'s sleeve.*

good_2_seo.name: {name}
good_2_seo.text: *At the end of the cherry blossom path, Seoyeon stops at the crosswalk.*

good_4_seo.name: {name}
good_4_seo.text: *Seoyeon crosses first, then slows near the middle.*

good_5_seo.name: {name}
good_5_seo.text: *On the other side, we make our next plan using only a time and place.*

good_epilogue_1.name: {name}
good_epilogue_1.text: *A message from Seoyeon: 'Lunch tomorrow. Rooftop. I made a proper reservation this time.'*

good_epilogue_2.name: {name}
good_epilogue_2.text: *In the photo, both our names are written in the noon slot of the access log. Beside them, in Seoyeon's handwriting: 'Don't be late.'*

good_epilogue_3.name: {name}
good_epilogue_3.text: *The next day, Seoyeon unlocks the door with the borrowed key and returns it immediately. She waits outside until {name} arrives.*

good_1_yuna.name: Yuna
good_1_yuna.text: ...You were late. Still — this time I read your sentence all the way to the end.

good_1_yuna_b.name: Yuna
good_1_yuna_b.text: *She hands me a folded note. When I open it, there's one line: 'Next time, tell me first.'*

good_1_yuna_b_b.name: {name}
good_1_yuna_b_b.text: *It's a short sentence. Ink has bled along the fold.*

good_2_yuna.name: {name}
good_2_yuna.text: *The rooftop. Yuna leans against the railing. Even with the wind blowing, she doesn't turn away first today.*

good_3_yuna.name: {name}
good_3_yuna.text: *We look at the same sky. She doesn't say much, but the silence isn't cold the way it used to be.*

good_4_yuna.name: Yuna
good_4_yuna.text: *She slips the bookmark into a new page, on the side without a fold mark.*

good_5_yuna.name: {name}
good_5_yuna.text: *We leave through the rooftop door and head down the stairs. Our steps are slow, but they don't stop.*

good_epilogue_1_yuna.name: {name}
good_epilogue_1_yuna.text: *A folded note falls from the bag. Creases mark where it was pressed against the lining for a long time. 'If you've finished volume 1, I'll lend you volume 2. — Yuna'*

good_epilogue_2_yuna.name: Yuna
good_epilogue_2_yuna.text: *Volume two after volume one. Tomorrow after today. Yuna folds the note and hands it to me.*

good_epilogue_3_yuna.name: {name}
good_epilogue_3_yuna.text: *On the back of the note, in small writing: '...Let's read the ending together.' The pale violet ink is smeared.*

good_1_dain.name: Dain
good_1_dain.text: Hey, things between us still aren't completely settled. But I made another appointment for my knee on Monday.

good_2_dain.name: {name}
good_2_dain.text: *At the school gate, Dain holds out a folded rehabilitation leaflet.*

good_3_dain.name: {name}
good_3_dain.text: *I take the leaflet. Only then does Dain smile.*

good_4_dain.name: Dain
good_4_dain.text: I'm not okay today. So let's take it slow.

good_5_dain.name: {name}
good_5_dain.text: *Dain holds out her fist first. When {name} gently bumps it, she smiles. They pass through the school gate and begin walking slowly at the pace Dain sets.*

good_epilogue_1_dain.name: {name}
good_epilogue_1_dain.text: *A message from Dain: 'Anyone want to join me for a rehab walk tomorrow morning?' The wording is more careful than usual.*

good_epilogue_2_dain.name: {name}
good_epilogue_2_dain.text: *A short question stays on the screen for a long time.*

day5_ending_friend.name: {name}
day5_ending_friend.text: *I decide not to confess. But I also decide not to vanish without saying anything.*

friend_1.name: {name}
friend_1.text: *Sitting on a park bench, I open the chat. This time, I don't close the text box.*

friend_2.name: {name}
friend_2.text: *I remember the sentence I never managed to send in Sojeong's chat.*

friend_3.name: {name}
friend_3.text: *I write to the end and send it: 'I'm not ready to ask us to change what we are. But I wanted to tell you that I'm grateful for you.'*

friend_4.name: {name}
friend_4.text: *A reply comes: 'I'm grateful too. See you at school tomorrow.'*

friend_4_seo.name: {name}
friend_4_seo.text: *Seoyeon replies: 'I understand. You actually finished what you wanted to say this time. See you tomorrow.'*

friend_4_dain.name: {name}
friend_4_dain.text: *Dain replies: 'Okay. Then show up like normal tomorrow. Don't be late.'*

friend_5.name: {name}
friend_5.text: *I answer with a short 'Okay,' then turn off the screen.*

friend_7.name: {name}
friend_7.text: *A read receipt appears beside the message I sent. This time, I don't erase it.*

friend_8.name: {name}
friend_8.text: *Graduation day. My phone gallery shows a group photo with my friends from this school. This time, I'm looking at the camera.*

friend_9.name: {name}
friend_9.text: *In the photo, we're friends. I don't need to hide another meaning behind that word.*

friend_10.name: {name}
friend_10.text: *I write in the group chat, 'Want to grab something to eat together after the ceremony?' Replies appear one by one the moment I send it.*

day5_ending_mayhem.name: {name}
day5_ending_mayhem.text: *All three chats are stuck on 'read'. I try to write a reply, then delete it at the first letter.*

mayhem_1.name: Seoyeon
mayhem_1.text: *She passes {name} in the hallway. She does not turn her head.*

mayhem_2.name: {name}
mayhem_2.text: *Yuna’s seat was empty. A single note on the desk. ‘It was fun.’ The period was the end.*

mayhem_3.name: Dain
mayhem_3.text: *Dain smiles like always. 'Take care.' The words fall flat at the end.*

mayhem_4.name: {name}
mayhem_4.text: *I looked at the backs of the three people. None of the three turned around.*

mayhem_5.name: {name}
mayhem_5.text: *Spring is ending. The cherry blossoms are falling. No one is by my side.*

mayhem_6.name: {name}
mayhem_6.text: *The words 'I like you' remain, but every chat is piled with questions I never answered.*

mayhem_7.name: {name}
mayhem_7.text: *I look at the unsent note beneath Sojeong's photo. A long chain of sent messages fills the chat. The screen goes dark without changing.*

day5_ending_harem.name: {name}
day5_ending_harem.text: *The answer catches in my throat. All three smiles stop at once.*

harem_1.name: Seoyeon
harem_1.text: I know you're being honest. That doesn't mean the three of us have to wait for you.

harem_1_b.name: Yuna
harem_1_b.text: *She lowers her head, then looks from Seoyeon to Dain. Her grip on the book doesn't loosen.*

harem_3.name: Dain
harem_3.text: Me too. Until you sort this out, I don't want to meet one-on-one.

harem_4.name: {name}
harem_4.text: I understand. I won't contact any of you privately for a while. I'm sorry.

harem_5.name: Seoyeon
harem_5.text: Then let's not meet separately for a while. And keep messages to things we actually need to discuss.

harem_6.name: {name}
harem_6.text: *I nod. The three of them walk away in different directions, leaving {name} standing there.*

harem_7.name: {name}
harem_7.text: *Next week's calendar is empty. I mute all three chats and leave the blank spaces alone.*

day5_seo_ending_freetalk_intro.name: {name}
day5_seo_ending_freetalk_intro.text: *After the ending, time carries them back to the familiar school rooftop. This time there are no scripted lines and no next scene.*

day5_seo_ending_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
day5_seo_ending_freetalk.text: *On the familiar rooftop, she looks at the protagonist and smiles softly.* No more scripted story. It's your turn to talk.
day5_seo_ending_freetalk.context: This is a bonus conversation after Seoyeon's character ending and epilogue are complete. Preserve the relationship, events, passage of time, and current ages established by that ending. Do not reopen or reroll the ending, invent a breakup, confession, or conflict that did not occur, or undo the completed story. Continue a private conversation after the conclusion.
day5_seo_ending_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon keeps her honesty and sense of responsibility, but now lets vulnerability and playful ease coexist around someone close. Preserve the distance, forms of address, and intimacy established by the ending, and receive the protagonist's reflections with care.

day5_yuna_ending_freetalk_intro.name: {name}
day5_yuna_ending_freetalk_intro.text: *After the epilogue, they sit together again in the quiet school annex.*

day5_yuna_ending_freetalk.name: Yuna
day5_yuna_ending_freetalk.text: *She places a bookmark in her book and leaves the seat beside her open.* For the chapter after the epilogue... you go first.
day5_yuna_ending_freetalk.context: This is a bonus conversation after Yuna's character ending and epilogue are complete. Preserve the relationship, events, passage of time, and current ages established by that ending. Do not reverse the conclusion or make a new relationship ruling. Continue their time together naturally after the completed story.
day5_yuna_ending_freetalk.personality: Yuna remains thoughtful and bookish, but now knows how to offer her thoughts and affection first to someone she trusts. Preserve the intimacy and forms of address established by the ending, and respond without rushing to interpret the protagonist's words.

day5_dain_ending_freetalk_intro.name: {name}
day5_dain_ending_freetalk_intro.text: *After the final scene, a ball bounces once in the familiar gym.*

day5_dain_ending_freetalk.name: Dain
day5_dain_ending_freetalk.text: *She sets the ball aside and beams.* Main story, complete! Now tell me everything you wanted to say.
day5_dain_ending_freetalk.context: This is a bonus conversation after Dain's character ending and epilogue are complete. Preserve the relationship, events, passage of time, and current ages established by that ending. Do not change her injury or career from the ending, and do not reassess the conclusion. Continue their conversation after the completed story.
day5_dain_ending_freetalk.personality: Dain is bright, direct, and quick to notice the feelings of someone close. Keep the maturity and current relationship established by the ending while naturally mixing teasing, encouragement, and candid affection.

day5_teacher_ending_freetalk_intro.name: {name}
day5_teacher_ending_freetalk_intro.text: *Life after graduation continues. A finished manuscript and two coffees rest on the café table.*

day5_teacher_ending_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
day5_teacher_ending_freetalk.text: *She closes the finished manuscript and looks across the table.* Want to write what comes after the last chapter together?
day5_teacher_ending_freetalk.context: This is a bonus conversation after the homeroom teacher's character ending and epilogue are complete. Preserve the graduation, adult timeline, ages, and relationship established by that ending. Never return to the earlier teacher-and-minor-student period to portray romance, and do not reassess the completed ending.
day5_teacher_ending_freetalk.personality: The former homeroom teacher is thoughtful and responsible, someone who has refined both her writing and relationships over time. Preserve the mature intimacy and forms of address from the ending, respect the protagonist as an equal adult, and speak with warmth and honesty.

day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_intro.name: {name}
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk_intro.text: *Life after graduation continues. At home, she finishes tidying and leaves the seat across from her open.*

day5_nurse_ending_freetalk.name: School Nurse
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk.text: *She closes the bandage box and turns back with an easy expression.* First aid is done. Now take your time and talk to me.
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk.context: This is a bonus conversation after the school nurse's character ending and epilogue are complete. Preserve the graduation, adult timeline, ages, and relationship established by that ending. Never return to the earlier nurse-and-minor-student period to portray romance, and do not reassess the completed ending.
day5_nurse_ending_freetalk.personality: The former school nurse is practical, caring, and attentive to the other person's condition. Preserve the equal adult relationship and forms of address from the ending; do not diagnose every remark, and share light humor and sincerity naturally.
